# Chapter 7: Political Identity – Nationalism, Religion, and Class

## 7.1: Nationalism, Religion, and Class in Comparative Perspective

::: callout-note
### Learning Objectives

By the end of this section, you will be able to:

- Distinguish between state-building nationalism, ethnic nationalism, and civic nationalism.
- Analyze the role of religion, secularism, and socioeconomic class in shaping political cleavages and party systems.
